input.prompt: Locked-off static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. Outdoor wedding reception during blue hour: long candlelit dinner tables under hanging white flower installations and trees. The natural light keeps changing continuously as the evening deepens: the early blue sky with its last faint glow on the horizon darkens into a deeper, richer late blue hour, the remaining daylight on the tables, flowers and trees fades and cools, and the warm candlelight and glowing lanterns become the main light. A gentle breeze slightly pushes the leaves and the hanging flowers so they sway softly, and the candle flames flicker and lean in the same light wind. Photorealistic, natural light, identical composition and objects throughout.
